title: formdata: reject NULL filename and buffer name options
body:
`CURLFORM_FILENAME` and `CURLFORM_BUFFER` share a branch that evaluates `strlen(avalue)` without checking whether the argument is NULL. The public header documents `CURL_FORMADD_NULL` for a NULL char pointer.

This check returns `CURL_FORMADD_NULL` before evaluating `strlen()`. Also add regression checks in `tests/libtest/lib1308.c` to exercise both options.
